_comment: Canonical config for the Meta Ads remote MCP server. Source: https://www.facebook.com/business/help/1456422242197840 (literal quote: 'The remote MCP server URL for our ads MCP server across all currently supported AI agents is: https://mcp.facebook.com/ads'). Auth is OAuth — first call triggers a Meta login + consent flow in your browser; the AI client stores the bearer token. No API key needed.
